policies.B3: Capital adequacy requirements are fulfilled when an entity possesses net capital of at least $1,500,000.
policies.B4: Prime brokerage authorization is granted if an entity holding institutional onboarding approval also satisfies capital adequacy requirements.
policies.B5: Standard vetting approval is passed either by maintaining FINRA broker-dealer registration, paying annual compliance fees of at least $100,000, and holding an active Anti-Money Laundering compliance certification, or by submitting a clean third-party risk review.
policies.B6: Third-party risk clearance is awarded when an entity provides an annual clean third-party risk review.

policies.B9: Flawless compliance record is achieved when an entity holds an active Anti-Money Laundering compliance certification, records no more than 1 annual regulatory fine, and completes at least 10 annual internal audit inspections.
policies.B10: Tier-one participant designation is assigned when an entity maintaining flawless compliance record also holds prime brokerage authorization.
policies.D3: Preferred market maker status is granted to an entity reaching tier-one participant designation.
